_note: FABRICATED fixture, not a run. It stands in for the metrics.json a decomposer run writes, so scripts/compare_decomposer_arms.py can be exercised without a GPU. The numbers below are invented and say nothing about any model. The smoke test copies tests/fixtures/predictions/decomposer_results_musique.json in beside this file as results.json.

definitions.prompt_tokens: tokenizer token count of the rendered prompt for that row
definitions.completion_tokens: number of newly generated tokens for that row
definitions.latency_seconds: wall clock around model.generate for that row (CUDA synchronized), excluding tokenization and decoding
definitions.excluded_rows: rows without a measurement (e.g. a --dry-run) are excluded
